intent: Prove the authoritative current WHM+WPS BOM/MTO identity before any cost reconciliation or estimate promotion.
guards: new upload timestamp is not source freshness proof
historical BOM cannot silently become current BOM
cost estimate cannot promote before authoritative source identity PASS
same item represented in WHM and WPS requires explicit scope ownership
source identity PASS does not itself award engineering or negotiation credit
PASS: one authoritative current WHM+WPS BOM/MTO source set is uniquely identified and SHA-bound
DEFER: authoritative source identity is missing, ambiguous, stale, or supersession unresolved
